note: Off the checklist order on purpose; never repeats 'goat' until turn 11 ('I have noted the goat problem').
lines: Namaskara, animal helpline. Tell me, what happened?
Oh, I am sorry. How old was the small one?
And how many are sick now?
What are you seeing in them?
Anything else? What about the mouth?
Did you buy any new animals recently?
And the breathing, is it normal?
Okay, I have noted the goat problem. Five goats, fever and loose motions, since four days. What is your name?
Tell me your phone number, please.
Nine nine zero zero one, two three four five six. Correct?
Let me read it back. Lakshmamma from Hosahalli, Ramanagara district. Five goats with fever and loose motions, one kid died, two breathing fast. I am marking this urgent. Is that correct?
The vet team will call you very soon. Please do not give any medicine till then. Goodbye.
